s1.hyp: You weigh about seventy kilograms. A blue whale can reach a hundred and fifty thousand. The Eiffel Tower, about ten million.

s2.hyp: Every human alive, put together around four hundred billion. The whole Earth six trillion trillion.

s3.hyp: The Sun outweighs three hundred and thirty thousand Earths. And a neutron star squeezes even more into a ball the size of a city.

s4.hyp: The black hole at the centre of our galaxy weighs four million Suns, packed smaller than Mercury's orbit.

s5.hyp: All the ordinary matter we can see comes to about fifty -three zeros of kilograms. And dark matter outweighs it five to one.
